propertySets.name: Pset_MobileTeleCommunicationsApplianceTypeRemoteRadioUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of  IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance and types of IfcMobileTelecommunicationsApplianceType with the predefined type set to REMOTERADIOUNIT.

properties.name: DownlinkRadioBand
properties.definition: Indicates the frequency range, delimited by a lower frequency and an upper frequency, allocated for downlink transmission.

properties.name: NumberOfCarriers
properties.definition: Indicates how many carrier frequencies can be managed by the device.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: UplinkRadioBand
properties.definition: Indicates the frequency range, delimited by a lower frequency and an upper frequency, allocated for uplink transmission.

properties.name: NumberOfTransceiversPerAntenna
properties.definition: Indicates the number of transceivers per antenna.

properties.name: RadiatedOutputPowerPerAntenna
properties.definition: Indicates the power of radio waves emitted by each antenna of the base transceiver station.

properties.name: AntennaType
properties.definition:
Indicates the type of antenna.

Indicates the type of antenna integrated in the device.

properties.name: RRUConnectionType
properties.definition: Indicates the connection type between the remote radio unit and baseband unit.
